text_block_list.text:
Fulfilling days always pass by in the 
blink of an eye, and today marks the end 
of our summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
choice_data_list: You don't want to leave, do you?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No, that is not it. I was making a vow.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Once training camp is over, next up is the 
Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll put everything I've worked hard for 
here into it and seize the victory for 
sure, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, once we get back to the academy, 
let's get training!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! But before that, it's time for the 
training camp celebration party♪

And so, leaving the training camp behind, 
the next goal in sight is the Sprinters 
Stakes!
